area: Whole-tenant Terraform export: terraform validate against the zia, zpa, ztc and zcc providers in CI (blocking); ACME test clock
title: Wave 10: the sample tenant's whole-tenant export validates against every provider, and the CI step that proves it is blocking

checks.what: CI validates the sample's zia, zpa, ztc and zcc workspaces (zcc 0.1.2-beta.3) in a terraform job, blocking: no continue-on-error, an init or validation failure fails the run
Every resource reference in every workspace of the sample export names a resource or data source that workspace declares
Cloud Connector forwarding rules with a forward method the provider rejects and IP pools with other than one range are listed as not exported with the reason
ACME renewal tests measure days left against an injected clock

findings.title: An object skipped for a missing required argument kept its address, so a resource rendered earlier referred to a resource the workspace never declared (terraform validate: Reference to undeclared resource)
findings.fix: a dry run drops the address of every object that cannot be written before any resource is rendered; references fall back to a lookup by name or the id

findings.title: Cloud Connector forwarding rules with forward method ZPA (or another the provider rejects) and IP pools with several ranges were written, making the ztc workspace invalid
findings.fix: kept only when the provider can express them; otherwise listed as not exported with the reason

findings.title: The sample tenant held values the providers reject (HTTP header Host/CONTAINS, forward method ZPA on a connector rule, a two-range IP pool)
findings.fix: sample values the API and the providers accept

findings.title: The whole-tenant validate step was advisory and had never run
findings.fix: blocking, in its own terraform job, one line per diagnostic
